name: Dashlane
description: Import and sync logins from Dashlane collections into Termix credentials.
features: Connect a Dashlane account with a service device key
Pick which Dashlane collections to import
Logins become Termix password credentials, filed in a folder per collection
Keeps them in sync on a schedule, or when you press Sync now
Removes credentials whose login left the chosen collections, if you want
Or keeps passwords in Dashlane: credentials hold a dashlane:// reference, resolved when a host connects

env.name: EMBEDDED_BACKEND_PORT
env.description: Termix's own internal API port. The plugin calls the credentials API there. Only set when Termix itself is set to a different port.
